scope: Unified Explore selector and inline public-product workflow; no new source or actual-model acceptance claim

regressions: Late old satellite page cannot replace a public product
AOI change aborts old product file checks
Explicit source choice invalidates a pending project restoration
Selecting a scene does not stop subsequent catalog pages
Agent receives the current product form without old imagery counts, acquisition dates or selection IDs

steps: Select WorldPop from the existing Data source dropdown
Enter NIU and the public test-country bounds
Resolve and check the actual published source
Explicitly save to the owned test project
Explicitly queue the complete original download
Open the saved project and inspect its real grayscale preview and raw pixel
Switch back to Earth Search with the same AOI
Select JRC and verify the old imagery state is absent and the AOI is preserved
